NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Tracta reads steps, distance, energy, heart rate, sleep and workouts to show your day.
NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Tracta saves the workouts and runs you record so they appear in Apple Health.
NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Tracta uses your location to map and measure your runs.
NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Tracta keeps measuring your run while the screen is locked.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Tracta lets you pick progress photos from your library.
NSCameraUsageDescription: Tracta uses the camera to take progress photos.
